value.rationale: The exact enumeration of all minimal missing subsequences for every ternary permutation power completes an infinite family previously analyzed only through shortest-absent counts, lower-bound families and generic algorithms. Its bivariate transfer matrix supplies the full length distribution and its rational scalar reduction a fixed recurrence; this addresses a natural smallest nonbinary periodic model from deletion-channel research.
